title: Pointy Stick and Wooden Sword
subtitle: Knowledge always clogs the throat, but fortunately, this story is both delectable and moving.

items.text: Pointy Stick and Wooden Sword
One month later
School of Primary Defense of Mankind
Students swarm to the end of the hallway, gazing up at the little jarl on the stairs.

items.speaker: Student I
items.text: Hey, don't push me!

items.speaker: Student II
items.text: Who stepped on my shoe!?

items.speaker: Student III
items.text: Shh, shush! Quiet down!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: ...In any case, as your jarl, I promise you fame, fortune, and... extra snacks!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Row those oars like never before, sailors! Just like the mysterious adventurers of old!
The crowd cheers in unison.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: You’re going to get caught by the instructors... then you’ll be locked in a dark room all day without any food. Breaking school rules is such a dumb idea.
His sharp voice pierces the excited atmosphere.
The excitement dissipates, and the little ones in robes start whispering, their eyes all focused on him.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: This is so unrealistic. I suggest you spend more time preparing for the next test. The students who score lowest will have to take extra classes to make up for it.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Most importantly, if you do poorly in Arcane Skills, you'll probably end up as janitors after graduation.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Sitting in a lonely office with a musty smell you can’t get rid of...
Children's minds are always so vividly imaginative.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Hmph, and I'll become the brightest star at the LSCC.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: You'd better start thinking more practically, like me...

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Are you kidding!? I've known many cowards like you before...

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Hmph, who's the coward? At least I don't need others to do my bidding.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: You...!

Erick’s face turns red with anger.
Just as she's about to storm over—
A hand grabs her.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: For the peace and welfare of mankind! What you're doing is completely pointless.
Like weather vanes, the crowd turn their heads to this new interloper.

items.speaker: Student I
items.text: It's Dreary Eifer! Run!

items.speaker: Student II
items.text: Ugh, she’s going to put me off my lunch...
The little robes scatter, leaving the three of them standing alone.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Hey, don't go! Our plan isn't even—

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Your plan is meaningless, regardless of whether you fail or succeed. In the end, you'll either face endless anxiety or insatiable emptiness.
The girl with the dim eyes points at the retreating crowd.

items.speaker: Effie
items.text: Even if you assemble them time and again, they’ll still walk away in the end.

items.speaker: Golden Key Sancho
items.text: Not true! Some people are meant for more! And the others...

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Agh... so annoying! Both of you, just shut up!
She storms over, kicking up a cloud of dust with each step.
A battle for glory is inevitable.
